mapper.insert: insert into fly_embedding (id, target_model, target_id, chunk, vector_json, embed_model, update_time) values (#{id}, #{targetModel}, #{targetId}, #{chunk}, #{vectorJson}, #{embedModel}, now())
mapper.select: select id, target_model, target_id, chunk, vector_json, embed_model, update_time from fly_embedding where target_model = #{targetModel}
select id, target_model, target_id, chunk, vector_json, embed_model, update_time from fly_embedding where target_model = #{targetModel} and target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.delete: delete from fly_embedding where target_model = #{targetModel} and target_id in #{i}
